  --get \
  --data-urlencode 'from=2025-07-01T00:00:00Z' \
  --data-urlencode 'to=2025-07-31T23:59:59Z' \
  --data-urlencode 'fields=level,temperature' \
  --data-urlencode 'series=raw'

# Omit series=raw to get the quality-checked series instead.
